notes: Reports now really do land in the dated folder. Chrome asks every extension where a download should go and gives the last word to the most recently installed one, so this extension's folder was only ever a request - and when something else overruled it, the files landed loose in Downloads while the run still reported success. It now checks where each file actually went, and fetches its own copy into the folder when Chrome put it somewhere else.

A report is no longer ticked green for a file that is not in the run folder. That is what the 9/10 runs with everything loose in Downloads were: a download that finished was being read as a download that landed.
